FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Culinary Haven operates as a retail store specializing in kitchen and home accessories, offering a curated selection of high-quality kitchen tools, cookware, utensils, and decor items. Our operations focus on providing an exceptional shopping experience through knowledgeable staff who assist customers in selecting the right products for their needs. We prioritize product safety and ensure that all our merchandise is sourced from reputable manufacturers with proven track records. Our inventory management system is designed for efficiency, allowing us to maintain optimal stock levels and respond to customer demand effectively. To enhance customer engagement, we conduct seasonal promotions and loyalty programs while strictly adhering to local zoning and safety regulations to mitigate any risks associated with our operations. We maintain a focus on retailing, ensuring that all transactions occur within the store.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Culinary Delights Boutique, LLC - 456 Culinary Ave, Foodtown, NY 12345-6789
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss on 09/10/2023 due to water damage from a burst pipe in the storage area, amounting to $2,500. Claim submitted and currently under review.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday: 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Medium Security Safe, Class B, UL-listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with video surveillance and security fencing.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Culinary Haven does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain an in-house team dedicated to our retail operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Culinary Haven does not currently carry Workers' Compensation insurance, as all employees are in-house and managed without leasing practices. The operations manager is responsible for overseeing compliance with safety regulations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Culinary Haven also owns and operates Culinary Delights Boutique, LLC, located at 456 Culinary Ave, Foodtown, NY. This additional business complements our focus on kitchen and home accessories.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Culinary Haven does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Currently, we only have the active policy listed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Culinary Haven is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we solely focus on retailing kitchen and home accessories sourced from reputable manufacturers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Culinary Haven does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations are focused solely on retailing kitchen and home accessories without such activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Culinary Haven has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a stable financial status.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Culinary Haven does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations are strictly focused on retailing kitchen and home accessories without any handling of such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Culinary Haven does not have any catastrophe exposure as it operates solely as a retail store without on-site installation or repair services, reducing associated risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Culinary Haven has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize compliance and ethical practices.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Culinary Haven has no uncorrected fire code violations and prioritizes compliance with all local safety regulations to ensure a safe shopping environment.
